## KaliScriber 0.12.0

Install the `arm64-v8a` APK on most phones (`universal` if unsure). It updates over earlier builds and keeps your meetings, settings and schedules.

### A Schedule tab
Scheduled recordings now have their own tab in the bottom bar.
- **Coming up:** everything that will be recorded in the next week, by day: your schedules and, when calendar auto-record is on, calendar meetings. Skip any one of them, or record it after all. What is being recorded now is marked.
- **Your schedules:** each with its next time and how it repeats. Pause one with its switch, tap it to edit, or delete it.
- What Android still needs to allow (microphone, display over other apps, full-screen notifications, exact alarms) is shown at the top, with a button for each.

### More to a schedule
The editor is now a full screen with:
- **Repeat** every day, on weekdays, every week, or **on chosen days** (say Monday and Thursday).
- **Notes format:** a built-in format (1:1, stand-up, sales call, interview, lecture) or one of your own, used when its notes are written.
- **People in the meeting**, so speakers are told apart better.
- **A reminder** 5, 10, 15 or 30 minutes before, with *Don't record* on it.
- **An agenda**, kept as a note with the recording.
- **Pause** a schedule without deleting it.
